decisionTitle: Operator note overrides original 'do not touch cli.js/lib.js' instruction: implemented --help in cli.js to turn the red acceptance green
rationale: This task's description originally forbade editing cli.js/lib.js and only asked for palindrome-checker/test/cli.test.js. That test file already existed on disk from a prior run (report_18.json previously recorded SUCCESS with 44/46 passing and 2 intentionally-failing --help tests, since cli.js had no --help flag). The task JSON now carries an appended operator note ('ВНИМАНИЕ ОПЕРАТОРА (после красной приёмки)') explicitly instructing to fix the IMPLEMENTATION (cli.js/lib.js) to satisfy the existing tests, without simplifying or removing tests, and to get 'npm --prefix palindrome-checker test' green before reporting. I followed the newer instruction since it supersedes the earlier scope restriction for this same task. Change made: cli.js's parseArgs() now recognizes a --help flag, and main() short-circuits on it before any stdin read, printing a small usage/help text (containing the word 'Usage') to stdout and exiting with code 0, with nothing written to stderr. No other behavior of cli.js/lib.js was changed, and test/cli.test.js was not modified. Verified with the exact unitTestCmd 'npm --prefix palindrome-checker test': 46/46 tests pass (0 failed).
